title: Equilibrium Dialysis Assay Using OT-2 and HTD Plate
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare and upload CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a .csv file with a header line and rows for each sample (sample number must be a multiple of 8). Include columns: N.º PROTEIN, VOLUME_EXCHANGE (µL), VOLUME_RESERVOIR (mL), TEMPERATURE_MODULE 1 (°C), TEMPERATURE_MODULE 2 (°C), TIME_PROTOCOL (min), TIME_INCUBATE (min). Example row: 96,300,195,4,4,840,30. Specify the initial buffer‑reservoir volume (mL) and which mount (left or right) will hold the P300 multi‑channel pipette. Upload this file to the OT‑2 protocol.

steps.title: Configure OT‑2 deck and mount plate
steps.instruction: Mount the HTD plate directly on the temperature module so that the bottom half of each well is accessible. Place the primary buffer reservoir on the temperature module. Load backup buffer reservoirs into deck slots 4, 5, and 6. Position waste reservoirs on the deck. Set the P300 multi‑channel pipette on the specified mount (left or right).

steps.title: Remove waste and change tips
steps.instruction: For each column up to the number of samples indicated in the CSV, aspirate waste from the bottom half of the wells and dispense it into the waste reservoir. After completing a column, discard the used tips and pick a fresh tip column. If any waste reservoir becomes full, the protocol pauses and the user must empty the reservoir before continuing.

steps.title: Distribute buffer and replenish reservoir
steps.instruction: Using one column of tips, aspirate the specified buffer volume from the reservoir on the temperature module and dispense it into the bottom half of the wells (from the top of the well). After distribution, replenish the temperature‑module reservoir with backup buffer taken from slots 4, 5, and 6. If backup buffer is exhausted before the CSV is finished, the protocol pauses and the user must replace the buffer.

steps.title: Incubate as specified in CSV
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for the TIME_INCUBATE minutes listed for each sample in the CSV while the temperature module maintains the temperatures set in TEMPERATURE_MODULE 1 and TEMPERATURE_MODULE 2. This incubation also allows the replenished buffer to reach the set temperature.
